universal_guidelines: Use 'Michroma' for all main headings to match the 'Eurostile Extended' look.
Action cards must use the specific color coding (Orange, Green, Yellow, Blue, Red).
The 'Emergency SOS' card must span full width (col-span-2).
Status indicator 'SYSTEM ACTIVE' must be a glowing green dot.
Use 'Exo 2' for body text to maintain the tech/civic feel.
Do not use gradients for backgrounds, stick to solid dark colors with subtle borders.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Install fonts via Google Fonts import in index.css. 2. Create the 'Dashboard' page as the main entry point. 3. Implement the grid layout exactly as described: 2 columns for action cards, full width for SOS. 4. Use Lucide-React icons inside colored circular backgrounds within the cards. 5. Ensure the 'Impact Score' card is White with Black text, and 'Days Active' is Dark with White text.
